info.title: HiTechCloud WAF Management API
info.description: Official management API for HiTechCloud WAF (web application firewall). 227 endpoints across 25 resource groups. Auth flow: GET /api/open/auth/csrf -> POST /api/open/auth/login (-> JWT) -> Bearer token on every call.
